name: Blind
desc: You are unable to See or Target beyond Touch Range without Spotting.

name: Restrained
desc: You are unable to take Movement Actions.

name: Prone
desc: Knocked or made Prone, you are Vulnerable to all Melee Attacks but Ranged Attacks against you are made with a Bane.

name: Stunned_x
desc: You begin your Turns with x less AP.

name: Vulnerable_x
desc: Damage is more Vicious against you by x.

name: Linked
desc: A Condition that ties Movement of two or more things. When A is Linked to B, A moves where and when B does.

name: Frenzied
desc: At the start of each Turn, you roll a Chaos Die, suffering the consequences according to your roll: You may act as normal. You must take at least 1 genuinely hostile Action like an Attack or other re…

name: Castigated
desc: You may not take Primary Actions.

name: Bleeding
desc: Unless Bandaged or otherwise stopped, you will Bleed Out and die within a number of Rounds equal to your Base Body.

name: Suffocating
desc: You become Stunned. For each Round after this, the Stun increases, and you become Unconscious once it increments to 6. At 10, you die.

name: On Fire
desc: You begin Suffocating, cannot Hold your Breath, and suffer a 1st Degree Burn. Each Round, the Permament Strain from this Burn increases by one until extinguished (or you die). The Severity of this In…

name: Doomed_x
desc: All applications of this Condition stack. When x equals your Tier, you suffer Major Panic Risk. When x is twice your Tier, you die.

name: Unconscious
desc: The Victim is unable to use any Actions and is Helpless.

name: Helpless
desc: The victim cannot use any Actions other than Communicate and all Injuries become Lethal for them.
